title: Ghame sheh mein
body:
ghame sheh mein jo aankhon se rawan hai
wo aansu qeemat e baaghe jina hai
<<DIVIDER>>
muqaddar hum bana lete hai jis se
kisi ke paas wo nuskha kahan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
baghair e ultaf e aale mohamed
amal kya zindagi bhi rayegan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jise kaaba kaha karti hai dunya
abu taalib ke bete ka makan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
saza e maut di baatil ko jis ne
wo ek cheh maah ka kanoon daan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hurr zinda raha hairaan kyun ho
dar e sheh par koi marta kahan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
azaan goonji ali akbar ki ran mein
sada pur soz hai lehja jawan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hai mansoob akbar se jahan mein
namazon ki muhafiz wo azaan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar ka ye sadqa hai gohar
khuda ka deen jo ab tak jawan hai
ghame sheh mein jo...
author: Gohar Jarchvi
